briefing.headline: RHI rockets 18.5% as overnight movers split between mega‑caps and high‑flyers
briefing.summary: The core mega‑cap tech group was split, with five advancers and five decliners, leaving the indices flat to slightly down. Meanwhile, smaller‑cap tokens delivered extreme moves, from HSTM plunging 58% to RHI gaining nearly 19%. Overall breadth was uneven, reflecting a mixed risk sentiment ahead of the US open.
